title: Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi (Theme 9: Majukumu ya mnunuzi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child sorts u- nouns: no plural (U-U: uji, upendo), plural with ma- (U-YA: ugonjwa/magonjwa), and agrees every word.
steps: Does it have a plural? With ma-?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Ugonjwa huu umeenea" and "Magonjwa haya yameenea".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Uji kimeiva." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Uji ni wa U-U na hutumia u-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi kwa wingi." Kwa nini "Magonjwa unaumiza." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?" Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa ugonjwa ni magonjwa: U-YA.
